name: Change Proceed To Checkout Text
author: Arrow Design

sections.description:
Change Proceed To Checkout Text provides a simple settings screen for changing the WooCommerce Proceed to Checkout button text.

The free plugin is fully functional without a licence, account or external service and supports both the classic WooCommerce cart and the modern WooCommerce Cart Block.

Change Proceed To Checkout Text Pro is an optional, separately installed commercial add-on available from Arrow Design. The Pro implementation and licence-validation code are not included in this WordPress.org plugin.

Pro adds additional WooCommerce button labels, a custom checkout destination and conditional Proceed to Checkout rules based on products, product categories, cart total, cart quantity, product type, login status, customer role, shipping method and payment method.

A 7-day Pro trial is available from Arrow Design.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Change Proceed To Checkout Text.
  2. Go to Settings > Checkout Button Text.
  3. Enter your preferred Proceed to Checkout text.
  4. The Pro Features tab explains the optional separately installed Pro add-on.
sections.faq:
Does the free plugin require a licence?

No. The free plugin does not contain a licence system.

Is Pro functionality included but locked?

No. Change Proceed To Checkout Text Pro is a separate add-on plugin distributed outside WordPress.org.

Does it support WooCommerce Blocks?

Yes. The free Proceed to Checkout label supports the WooCommerce Cart Block as well as the classic cart.

  • Added a clean tabbed settings screen with a separate Pro Features information tab.
